spec.title: Ports Down
spec.description:
NVLink connections between a GPU and an NVSwitch that are down right now.

A GPU with a link down keeps working but exchanges data with the others more slowly.

No data means no port reported in the last 5 minutes.

spec.expr:
count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} == 0)
or (0 * count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}))
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: Degraded Ports
spec.description: NVLink ports in safe mode or reporting a problem while their link is still up.

spec.expr:
count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch", hw_type="network", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"} == 1) >= 1)
or (0 * count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}))
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: Switch Problems
spec.description: NVSwitch chips that failed, are degraded, or sit at or above a temperature limit.

spec.expr:
count(max by (host_name, id) (
  max by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"failed|degraded|predicted_failure"} == 1)
  or label_replace((max by (host_name, hw_parent_id, name) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}) >= on (host_name, hw_parent_id) group_left () min by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (hw_temperature_limit_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch", limit_type="high.degraded"})) * 0 + 1, "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")
) >= 1)
or (0 * count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"present"} == 1)))
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: GPUs With Fabric Issues
spec.description: GPUs whose fabric or Fabric Manager state is degraded or failed, such as reduced bandwidth or a configuration error.

spec.expr:
count(max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem=~"fabric|fabric-manager", state=~"degraded|failed|predicted_failure"} == 1))
or (0 * count(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present"}))
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: Problems
spec.description:
Everything wrong with the fabric right now, worst first. Healthy ports and switches are not listed.

Device: the NVSwitch, the port with the GPU and the link at its other end, or the GPU. When a port's GPU stopped reporting, the GPU and link it reached when last seen in the past 7 days, marked last known.

Since: when the problem first showed in the selected period. Started before this period means it was already there, so the moment it started is outside the period.

NVLink port flapping means the link changed state four or more times in the last hour and is up now. A port that is down is listed as down instead.

Click a device to open the Port History of its server, which keeps the ports that went down, counted errors or went silent.

value.title: Open the history of this server

spec.title: Fabric by Server
spec.description:
The NVLink fabric of each server: how much of it there is, what is wrong with it, and how busy it is.

Ports Down counts the NVLink ports of the server whose link is down. Errors adds up the transmission errors of all of its ports over the selected period.

Traffic is what the ports of the server are carrying right now, both directions together.

Click a server to look at it alone.

spec.expr: max by (key) (label_join((count by (host_name) (max by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"present"} == 1))), "key", "/", "host_name"))
max by (key) (label_join((count by (host_name) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})), "key", "/", "host_name"))

max by (key) (label_join((count by (host_name) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} == 0)
or (0 * count by (host_name) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}))), "key", "/", "host_name"))

max by (key) (label_join((sum by (host_name) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range]))), "key", "/", "host_name"))

max by (key) (label_join((sum by (host_name) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval]))), "key", "/", "host_name"))

max by (key) (label_join((max by (host_name) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})), "key", "/", "host_name"))

spec.title: Link State
spec.description:
Whether each NVLink port was up, over the period. Only the ports worth looking at: down at some point, counting errors, or gone quiet while their server kept reporting. Picking a host or a switch narrows that set.

Not reported means the port sent nothing. An exporter restart drops a port that is down from its list, which looks the same.

spec.expr:
label_join(((
max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})
or on (host_name, id) (0 * (max by (host_name, id) (last_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range]))) - 1)
) and on (host_name, id) ((
  (max by (host_name, id) (min_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range] @ end()) == 0))
  or (sum by (host_name, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)
  or ((max by (host_name, id) (last_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range] @ end())) unless max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} @ end()))
    and on (host_name) (max by (host_name) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink"} @ end())))
))), "row", " ", "host_name", "id")
or (
  (label_replace(vector(2), "row", "No port had a problem", "", "") and on () (count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})))
  or (label_replace(vector(2), "row", "No NVLink port reported", "", "") unless on () (count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})))
) unless on () (count((
  (max by (host_name, id) (min_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range] @ end()) == 0))
  or (sum by (host_name, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)
  or ((max by (host_name, id) (last_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range] @ end())) unless max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} @ end()))
    and on (host_name) (max by (host_name) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink"} @ end())))
)))

spec.title: Port Traffic
spec.description:
Data going through the NVLink ports of the selected servers altogether, sent above the line and received below it.

The traffic counters drop slightly several times an hour, which makes the rate spike.

spec.expr: sum (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch", direction="transmit"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch", direction="receive"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Port Errors
spec.description:
Transmission errors counted on the NVLink ports of the selected servers altogether, by type.

crc, ecc and flit are corrupted data, drawn in orange, red and yellow. recovery and replay are the link repairing itself, drawn in purple.

Occasional errors that the hardware corrects are normal. A rising trend points to a failing link, port or cable.

spec.expr: sum by (hw_error_type) (rate(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description:
Every NVLink connection between an NVSwitch and a GPU in the selected servers. Links that are down come first, then ports with errors, then the busiest.

Port ID: the name the port keeps when its GPU stops reporting, and what Link State above names its rows by.

Port: the NVSwitch port, and the GPU and link at its other end. When that GPU stopped reporting, the GPU and link the port reached when last seen in the past 7 days, marked last known.

Link: whether the connection is up.

Flaps: how many times the link changed state over the selected period. Two means it went down and came back. Four or more within one hour lists the port as flapping in Problems, while it is up.

Traffic: data currently going through the port in its busier direction, so that it compares with Bandwidth. Not reported means the port has no traffic counter.

Traffic Trend: Traffic over the selected period, capped at Bandwidth so that a counter glitch does not flatten the rest of the line.

Bandwidth: maximum speed of the connection in one direction. N/A when the port does not report it.

Utilization: Traffic as a share of Bandwidth. Near 100% the link is saturated and holds back the jobs that use it. N/A means the bandwidth or the traffic of the link is not known.

Errors: transmission errors counted on the port over the selected period. Not reported means the port has no error counter.

spec.expr:
max by (key) (label_join((max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval]))
or (0 * max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}) - 1)), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((sum by (host_name, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range]))
or (0 * max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}) - 1)), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} > 0)), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((changes((max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}))[$__range:1m])), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join(((max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval])) <= max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}))
or (max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}) < max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval])))
or max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval]))), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

spec.title: NVSwitches
spec.description: NVSwitch chips in the selected servers. They connect the GPUs inside a server so that they can exchange data at full speed.

spec.expr:
count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"present"} == 1))
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: NVLink Ports
spec.description: NVSwitch ports reporting in the selected servers. The exporter watches only the ports that are up when it starts, so a missing port is not a healthy port.

spec.expr:
count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: Ports Up
spec.description: NVLink ports whose link is up right now.

spec.expr:
count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} == 1)
or (0 * count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}))
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: Hottest Switch
spec.description: Highest NVSwitch temperature in the selected servers. The switch table below gives the limits of each one.

spec.expr:
max(hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})
or (vector(0)/0)

spec.title: Busiest Ports
spec.description: The ten NVLink ports closest to saturation, as a share of their bandwidth in the busier direction. Near 100% the link holds back the jobs that use it.

spec.expr:
topk(10,
  max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval]))
  /
  max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} > 0)
)

spec.title: Traffic by Server
spec.description:
Data the NVLink ports of each server carried over the period, sent and received together. The busiest server comes first and the tiles darken toward the quietest, so whoever drove the fabric stands out. Clicking a tile narrows the dashboard to that server.

Fabric by Server at the top gives the rate of the moment instead, which answers what is busy now rather than what moved the data.

spec.expr: sort_desc(sum by (host_name) (increase(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range])))

spec.description:
Every NVSwitch chip in the selected servers.

Status: Failed when the switch needs a reset or hit a fatal error, Degraded when it reports a problem it survived. Unknown when the switch is there but reports no health at all.

Temperature: current chip temperature. Degraded Limit is where it starts slowing down, Critical Limit where it shuts down.

Power: the VDD, DVDD and HVDD rails together. Not reported on switch models that publish only some of them.

Ports and Ports Down count the NVLink ports of this switch. Traffic and Errors add up all of them.

spec.expr:
label_join((max by (host_name, id, name) (
  2 * (max by (host_name, id, name) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"failed"} == 1))
  or (max by (host_name, id, name) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"} == 1))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, id, name) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"ok"} == 1))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, id, name) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", id=~"$nvswitch", state=~"present"} == 1) - 1)
)), "key", "/", "host_name", "id")

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(max by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}), "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(min by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (hw_temperature_limit_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch", limit_type="high.degraded"}), "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(min by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (hw_temperature_limit_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch", limit_type="high.critical"}), "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((max by (host_name, id) (hw_power_watts{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", id=~"$nvswitch"})), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(count by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}), "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(count by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"} == 0)
or (0 * count by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})), "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(sum by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__rate_interval])), "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

max by (key) (label_join((label_replace(sum by (host_name, hw_parent_id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range])), "id", "$1", "hw_parent_id", "(.*)")), "key", "/", "host_name", "id"))

spec.title: Switch Temperature
spec.description: Highest NVSwitch temperature of each server over the period. The table above gives the temperature and the limits of each switch.

spec.expr: max by (host_name) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", name=~"NVSwitch.*", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"})

spec.title: Switch Power
spec.description:
Power the NVSwitches of the selected servers draw altogether over the period, their VDD, DVDD and HVDD rails included.

The table above gives the power of each switch. Picking a server narrows this to it.

spec.expr: sum (hw_power_watts{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="other_device", id=~"$nvswitch"})

spec.title: GPU NVLink Errors by Type
spec.description: Error rate the GPUs themselves report on their NVLink connections.

spec.expr: sum by (hw_error_type) (rate(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_error_type=~"nvlink-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: PCIe Errors
spec.description: Error rate on the PCIe connection between each GPU and the rest of its server.

spec.expr: sum by (hw_error_type) (rate(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_error_type=~"pcie-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Errors by Port
spec.description:
NVSwitch ports that counted at least one error over the selected period, worst first. One row per type of error.

The ports are counted by their id, which does not change when the GPU at the other end stops reporting and the port name loses it.

Ports without error counters are not listed, and neither are ports with no error.

spec.expr: sum by (host_name, id, hw_error_type) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", hw_parent_id=~"$nvswitch"}[$__range])) > 0

spec.title: GPUs With Fabric Problems
spec.description:
GPUs whose fabric or Fabric Manager state was not OK at some point in the period. The fabric is what lets the GPUs of a server talk to each other through the NVSwitches.

State is the worst state of the period, not the state right now. Problems above lists what is wrong at this moment.

spec.expr:
2 * (max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_subsystem) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem=~"fabric|fabric-manager", state=~"failed"}[$__range])) == 1)
or (max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_subsystem) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem=~"fabric|fabric-manager", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"}[$__range])) == 1)

spec.title: GPU NVLink Traffic
spec.description: Data the GPUs of the selected servers exchanged over all of their NVLink connections together, sent above the line and received below it.

spec.expr: sum (rate(hw_gpu_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", interface="nvlink", direction="transmit"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum (rate(hw_gpu_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", interface="nvlink", direction="receive"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Fabric Conditions
spec.description:
Fabric conditions the GPUs report, such as degraded bandwidth or a route recovering. Only the conditions that hold right now are listed.

No data means no GPU reports a fabric condition, which is also the case when the agent does not publish them.

spec.expr: max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_fabric_condition_type) (hw_gpu_fabric_condition_active_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""}) == 1

spec.title: Fabric Configuration
spec.description:
The fabric configuration each GPU reports, and whether a fabric partition has taken it.

Configuration: ok means the configuration is correct. Every other value names what is wrong with it, such as insufficient-nvlinks or incorrect-system-guid.

Partition: whether the GPU has been assigned to a fabric partition. Not a fault on a server whose GPUs are not partitioned, and N/A on a GPU that cannot report it.

A GPU listed here reports one of the two, so Configuration reads N/A on a card that reports its partition and not its configuration.

No data means no GPU reports either, which is also the case when the agent does not publish them.

spec.expr: label_join((max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index) (hw_gpu_fabric_configuration_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""} or hw_gpu_fabric_partition_assigned{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""})), "key", "/", "host_name", "hw_gpu_index")

max by (key, state) (label_join((max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, state) (hw_gpu_fabric_configuration_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""}) == 1), "key", "/", "host_name", "hw_gpu_index"))
or label_replace(
  max by (key) (label_join((max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index) (hw_gpu_fabric_configuration_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""} or hw_gpu_fabric_partition_assigned{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""})), "key", "/", "host_name", "hw_gpu_index")) unless on (key) (max by (key, state) (label_join((max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, state) (hw_gpu_fabric_configuration_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""}) == 1), "key", "/", "host_name", "hw_gpu_index"))),
  "state", "N/A", "", "")

max by (key) (label_join((max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index) (hw_gpu_fabric_partition_assigned{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""})), "key", "/", "host_name", "hw_gpu_index"))

spec.description:
Lists the MetricsHub agents feeding this dashboard.

Version, Build Date, Build Number: version and build of the agent.

Connectors Version: version of the connectors library used by the agent.

Last Seen: last time the agent reported metrics. An agent that has not been seen recently means its GPUs are no longer being monitored.

spec.expr:
topk by (agent_host_name) (
  1,
  last_over_time(timestamp(metricshub_agent_info)[6h:])
)

spec.title: Dashboard Version
spec.description: Version of this dashboard.

spec.name: host_name
spec.label: Host

spec.query: query_result(count by (host_name) (max_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink"}[1d]) or max_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink"}[$__range])) or count by (host_name) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", state="present"}[1d]) or max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", state="present"}[$__range])))

spec.definition: query_result(count by (host_name) (max_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink"}[1d]) or max_over_time(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink"}[$__range])) or count by (host_name) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", state="present"}[1d]) or max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", state="present"}[$__range])))
